settings.filament_notes: TinManX1 PET-CF field tune 2026-08-04: supersedes the July 11 300C / 1.08-flow rescue profile. Use 285C first layer / 280C print, 80C bed, 50C active chamber on supported TinMan machines, flow 1.00, max volumetric 3.2 mm3/s, limited overhang cooling, and pressure advance 0.028. Fiberon permits room-temperature chambers; the controlled 50C target is the TinMan field-quality setting. Dry at 100C for 10h.

tinmanxProfileTune.reason: Final field-quality PET-CF contract after the emergency July 11 rescue profile and July 27 Bambu surface-tune validation.
tinmanxProfileTune.changes: 285C first layer, 280C steady nozzle, 3.2 mm3/s max volumetric, flow 1.00, limited overhang cooling, active 50C chamber, pressure advance enabled.
